name: msi_capacity_v1
initialization: All from random weights. No pretrained weights. Existing fixed holdouts and training-only normalization retained.
selection: Same 128 fixed validation sites, 18 allowed scenarios. Yield balanced crop/group normalized MSE. SOC autonomous 24-year pool plus SOMSC normalized loss. No test metrics for selection.
split_policy: Existing 7805 train / 975 validation / 975 test; 176 train scenarios; 22 reserved scenarios excluded from optimization and selection.
interpretation: Iterated internal benchmark. Completion is based on crop and management effects, annual SOC changes and long rollout drift, not aggregate stock/yield R2 alone.

hypotheses.yield_capacity: Matched width128 and width512 compared with delivery context width256; all remaining hyperparameters fixed.
hypotheses.soc_capacity: Width512 compared with delivery monthly K8 width256, 60 epochs.
hypotheses.soc_positivity: Width256 with smooth nonnegative annual and auxiliary monthly pool outputs, compared with delivery monthly K8; same weights at initialization and same sampling.
